subject.title: [Bug]: publishable plugin runtime builds cannot emit native CJS entrypoints

question: Should OpenClaw accept an opt-in `openclaw.build.runtimeFormat` package build surface so msteams can publish native `.cjs` runtime sidecars?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the fix changes official plugin package build metadata and the issue is protected with the `maintainer` label, so cleanup automation should not independently close or queue competing repair work.

options.title: Review linked CJS opt-in PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102366 as the candidate fix if it proves msteams CJS output while preserving default ESM builds.

options.title: Keep runtime packages ESM-only
options.body: Reject the new build surface and close the linked PR if maintainers want startup performance solved without native CJS package output.

options.title: Request a narrower packaging design
options.body: Ask for a different package-build contract if `runtimeFormat` is too broad for long-term plugin metadata.

recommendation.title: Review linked CJS opt-in PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102366 as the candidate fix if it proves msteams CJS output while preserving default ESM builds.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the current plugin packaging refactor that introduced the helper and metadata now under review.
